definitions.gloss: return gift for condolence money; reciprocal gift after a funeral
definitions.explanation: A gift given by the bereaved family to those who offered condolence money ({香典|こうでん}) at a funeral. Part of the Japanese custom of reciprocating gifts. Typically given after the 49-day mourning period.

examples.japanese: {香典返|こうでんがえ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: To send a return gift for condolence money.

examples.japanese: {香典返|こうでんがえ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{迷|まよ}った→迷う：02426_mayou⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't decide what to choose for the condolence return gift.

examples.japanese: ⟦{四十九日|しじゅうくにち}→四十九日：06017_shijuukunichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{香典返|こうでんがえ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手配|てはい}→手配：07604_tehai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I arranged the condolence return gifts after the 49th-day memorial service.

notes: Composed of ⟦{香典|こうでん}→香典：06127_kouden⟧ (condolence money given at funerals) + ⟦{返|かえ}し→返し：24802_kaeshi⟧ (return, reciprocation). The return gift is typically worth about half the value of the condolence money received ({半返|はんがえ}し). Common choices include tea, towels, soap, and catalog gifts. Usually sent after the ⟦{四十九日|しじゅうくにち}→四十九日：06017_shijuukunichi⟧ (49-day mourning period). This custom reflects the broader Japanese practice of ⟦{返礼|へんれい}→返礼：16228_henrei⟧ (gift reciprocation). Related: ⟦{内祝|うちいわ}い→内祝い：16037_uchiiwai⟧ (return gift for celebratory occasions).
